paragraphs.text: Parisha is an Azorius arrester serving the Ninth Precinct. She is an imposing woman with sigiled armor and cobalt trappings.

Parisha was on the hunt for the Rakdos renegade Vadax Gor , suspected in the disappearance of two citizens. She needed someone to act as bait to catch the criminal. Spotting Fblthp in the Azorius gardens, she approached him and bid him come with her to New Prahv , where she read the mission details to him, then brought him to a leatherworker's shop near where the two other kidnappings had taken place.

After having Fblthp ask the leatherworker to sign some papers, Parisha revealed herself to the homunculus dressed in a commoner's clothing and pretending to buy fruit to alleviate his fears. But when Fblthp ducked into the alley, he was snatched away faster than Parisha could catch the culprit, and her agents found themselves under attack by the leatherworker's thugs. Parisha chased after Vadax Gor through several alleys, and when caught up, she threw an arrester's circle on the criminal and wrestled Fblthp from his grip.

Parisha and Fblthp returned to New Prahv and received praise for the successful capture of Vadax Gor from an Azorius senator. Although the homunculus was happy the ordeal was over, Parisha caused him fear anew, when she mentioned the next time .
